enabled.description: Enabled must be true for the connection to be valid

options.description: Additional SSH options as key-value pairs (e.g. StrictHostKeyChecking: false)

address.description: Address of the remote host (IP or hostname)

loadbalancer.description: is the hostname clients use to reach the cluster control plane.

profiles.description: maps a profile name to host and engine overrides that a host can select.

registries.description: lists the container registries the cluster uses.

ZarfClusterFiles.description: defines a file to write to a host.

data.description: holds inline content for the file, as an alternative to Source.

dst.description: is the path on the host where cargoship writes the file.

dstDir.description: is the directory on the host where cargoship writes the file.

group.description: identifies the file group on the host.

name.description: identifies the file in the cluster configuration.

perm.description: sets the file mode cargoship applies on the host.

src.description: is the local path or URL cargoship reads the file from.

user.description: identifies the file owner on the host.

ZarfClusterMetadata.description: holds identifying information for a cluster.

name.description: sets the cluster name. If you allow cargoship to update the kubeconfig, cargoship uses this name there.

ZarfClusterProfiles.description: holds the host and engine overrides for one profile.

concurrency.description:
limits how many hosts using this profile cargoship processes at once, e.g.
draining, upgrading, initializing, or uninstalling. It accepts a fixed count ("1") or a
percentage of the hosts sharing this profile ("25%"). Empty falls back to the phase's
default concurrency.

engine.description: holds the node label and taint overrides applied to a host that selects this profile.

host.description: holds the configuration overrides applied to a host that selects this profile.

ZarfClusterRegistries.description: holds the credentials and pull proxy for one container registry.

auth.description: holds the credentials for the registry.

proxy.description: holds the pull redirect settings for the registry.

ZarfClusterRegistryAuth.description: holds the credentials for a container registry.

pass.description: is the login secret for the remote registry.

token.description: authenticates to the remote registry instead of a username and password.

user.description: is the login name for the remote registry.

ZarfClusterRegistryProxy.description: redirects pulls for a registry to a different URL.

rewrite.description:
maps a regex pattern to a replacement, transforming the image name (not the tag)
before it is pulled from this mirror. See https://docs.rke2.io/install/private_registry#rewrites

url.description: is the registry address the engine pulls from instead of the original registry.

ZarfClusterSpec.description: holds the configuration and hosts for a cluster.

hosts.description: lists the hosts that make up the cluster.

ZarfFirewallConfig.description: is the backend-neutral firewall configuration for a node.

rules.description: lists the firewall rules cargoship applies to the node.

ZarfFirewallPolicyConfig.description: configures a firewalld policy that opens ports from one zone to another.

egress.description: is the zone the policy allows traffic to.

ingress.description: is the zone the policy allows traffic from.

ports.description: lists the ports this policy allows.

target.description: is the action taken on traffic that matches the policy.

ZarfFirewallPort.description: defines a port allowed through the firewalld policy.

port.description: is the port number, or port range, cargoship opens.

protocol.description: is the type of allowed traffic.

ZarfFirewallRule.description: is a single backend-neutral firewall rule.

action.description: is what cargoship does with traffic that matches the rule.

destination.description: is the address or CIDR the traffic goes to.

direction.description: selects which traffic the rule matches. It defaults to in.

egress.description:
names where forward traffic leaves. It is a zone on firewalld hosts and an
interface on ufw hosts. It applies to forward rules only.

ingress.description:
names where forward traffic enters. It is a zone on firewalld hosts and an
interface on ufw hosts. It applies to forward rules only.

name.description:
identifies the rule. Cargoship uses it to name the artifacts it writes on the
node, so it must be unique within a host. Cargoship generates one when it is empty.

port.description: is the port number, or inclusive port range, the rule matches.

protocol.description: is the type of traffic the rule matches.

source.description: is the address or CIDR the traffic comes from.

ZarfFirewallZone.description: is the name of either the ingress or egress zone for a policy.

ZarfHost.description: is a remote connection to a node

engine.description: holds the node label and taint overrides for this node.

environment.description: maps environment variables cargoship sets on the host.

files.description: lists files cargoship uploads to the host.

host.description: holds the host-level configuration overrides for this node.

hostname.description: overrides the discovered name of the node.

privateAddress.description: overrides the discovered private address of the node.

privateInterface.description: overrides the discovered private interface of the node.

profile.description: selects a profile by name from the cluster config's Profiles map.

role.description: sets the node role when cargoship adds this host to the cluster. It must be controller or worker.

ZarfHostConfig.description: defines the configuration for a specific host, including firewall policies and the ports cargoship opens on the node.

firewall.description:
holds the backend-neutral firewall rules cargoship renders onto whichever
firewall the node runs, firewalld, ufw, or nftables.

policy.description:
maps a policy name to a firewalld policy that allows traffic from one interface to another.
It is firewalld-only; prefer forward rules under `firewall.rules` for new configuration.

ports.description: lists the ports and protocols cargoship opens on the node.

ZarfHostEngine.description: defines configuration options for node-level metadata, specifically Kubernetes node labels and taints applied to a cluster host.

labels.description: maps Kubernetes node label keys to their values.

taints.description: lists the Kubernetes node taints cargoship applies to the node.

ZarfHostPort.description: is a port cargoship opens on the public side of the firewall.

port.description: is the port number, or port range, cargoship opens.

protocol.description: is the type of allowed traffic.

ZarfHosts.description: is an ordered list of hosts that cargoship manages together.

description: is the root object of a cluster configuration document.

apiVersion.description: identifies the API group and version of this configuration document.

kind.description: identifies the document type. The value must be ZarfCluster.

metadata.description: holds identifying information for the cluster.

spec.description: holds the configuration and hosts for the cluster.
